authorization.source: Direct user message in the existing Codex conversation on 2026-10-04, following coordinator handoff 0c8fe042.
authorization.grant: Разрешаю узкое расширение ISC-S16-D01 для proof-only работы над существующим обязательством DeltaReduce.nativeArithmeticRecoveryRefines и его axiom audit. Исключение из запрета R3 относится только к названному обязательству и необходимым вспомогательным леммам.

allowed: Proof sources discharging the existing DeltaReduce.nativeArithmeticRecoveryRefines obligation without changing its required content or domain.
Strictly necessary auxiliary lemmas and mandatory-project registration/imports.
Axiom audit of the actual theorem statement, assumptions and applicability.
Preparation and verification of the pinned environment.
New source-bound evidence and required checks; preserve historical reports unchanged.
excluded: Other R3 obligations or general R3 authorization
Protocol or model changes, including production Init/Next
Source-domain changes or new source/provenance binding
Gate weakening or historical evidence rewriting
proof_integrity: No trivial declaration under the required theorem name.
No hidden domain restriction or assumption of the refinement conclusion.
An excluded missing dependency must be reported, not promoted to an assumption.
Verify theorem content, assumptions and applicability in addition to declaration identity.

required: Commit the consistent Git amendment on the canonical branch.
Reflect the exception in the live nginx-qa assignment and future D01 profile/task using a supported in-place mechanism.
Verify assignment, accepted commits, history and reviewer decisions are preserved.

prerequisite_checkpoint.budget_scope: Initial investigation budget only; not a theorem completion estimate or protocol deadline.
prerequisite_checkpoint.start_condition: Activation gate satisfied and D01 assigned by the existing graph.
required_contents: Exact required theorem statement and link to the existing PO-AB1 recovery obligation.
Dependencies partitioned into already proved results, already authorized external assumptions, and open obligations.
Explicit determination whether unfinished R2.3, new source/provenance binding or model changes are necessary.
Finite proposed proof-file and verification scope.
prerequisite_checkpoint.avoid: Do not repeat the completed general inventory; assess dependencies of the missing recovery theorem specifically.

route: two existing process reviews of the exact checkpoint commit
continuation_requires: Two APPROVE decisions for the exact prerequisite report commit.
The report positively establishes sufficiency within this named exception.
No excluded dependency is needed or assumed away.
Git and live scope remain synchronized.
review_limits: Scope-amendment approvals cannot substitute for prerequisite-report approvals.
Approving an accurate report of an excluded prerequisite does not authorize that prerequisite.
Material checkpoint revisions require two reviews of the revised commit.
Process reviews are not independent formal attestations.

conditional_continuation: After the prerequisite checkpoint satisfies the stated conditions, continue the named proof and necessary lemmas without seeking permission for every lemma. Stop on any excluded dependency.
after_theorem: After actual discharge and required checks, return to the original D01 integration points and then Q01. One theorem does not close D01, all R3 or Formal GO.
known_failure: The known FAIL still blocks integration. This amendment authorizes only investigation and repair of its named cause under the activation and checkpoint gates.

historical_preservation.supersedes_only: The authority prohibition for the named proof-only obligation after activation; it does not rewrite historical facts or convert prior NO_GO to GO.
